description.en: A conservative eurypterid reconstruction with a broad domed headshield, short anterior feeding limbs and a heavy tapering trunk. Missing limb segments and body thickness are estimated from several same-species specimens.
description.zh: 保守的板足鲎活体复原，具有宽拱头盾、短前部摄食附肢和厚重渐细躯干。缺失足节与体厚依据多件同种标本估计。

anatomy: Wide rounded domed headshield with posterolateral lobes; paired small lateral eyes plus median ocelli, modest lunulate ornament, no giant modern horseshoe crab eye stalks.
AppendageI small chelicerae under mouth. II andIII short robust gathering limbs with flat sensory flanges/spines; not long lobster claws or dense Cyrtoctenus filtering combs.

PairIV intermediate limb with sensory tibial spine but non-sensory distal podomeres, small articulated tarsal spur and terminal tarsus. IV also contributes support. V andVI stout walking limbs of unequal length, VI longest. Five postcheliceral pairs total, no added paddle pair.

At least three locomotory pairs IV-VI are consistent with trackway reconstruction. Two posterior pairs preserved in BMNH underpin scale; complete distal V/VI conservative inference, not direct preserved anatomy.

Broad heavy anterior opisthosoma narrowing through posterior segments, approximately12 segments according to conventional eurypterid reconstruction; dorsal lateral pleurae modest, not trilobite spines.
Terminal pointed telson with ventral keel, raised shoulders and median groove. Tail tapers behind body, no swimming paddle, poison sting, paired sickle cercal blades or lobster fan.
Low ventral plates/metastoma visible where appropriate. Muted matte brown live colors illustrative, not inferred from rock.
restoration_boundaries: BMNH In.62181 actual specimen Fig2b/c and interpreted Fig1 are main anchor, not lectotypeG55/76. Restore distortion and do not model tucked-under burial geometry as normal posture.
Same-species tail NMS G1992.14.6 Fig3f is a separate specimen. Use form, not its independent size as main-body measurement.
GLAHM A23078 Fig4A supports probable fourth appendage terminal. Fig4B belongs cfDunsopterus and must not be borrowed.
Fig2a belongs Cyrtoctenus and must not be used as Hibbertopterus dense filtering comb.1994 etched sensory rings did not show hairs, despite older interpretation.

Whyte2005 Fig1c is a whole hibbertopteroid trackmaker reconstruction with left limbs omitted for clarity. Restore bilateral symmetry, not three legs total; do not claim that trackmaker is selected specimen.
Missing distal legs, absolute total length, depth, posture and color are conservative reconstruction choices. No old swimmer reconstruction.

scale.uncertainty: Fig1 x0.5 printed magnification and image proportions give head width approximately110-120mm; distorted outline. Total300mm is our conservative completion, not specimen measurement. Do not use650mm giant carapace or1.6m trackmaker total.

scientific_limits.en: Main anatomical anchor BMNH In.62181 is distorted, with posterior body curled under the head and distal posterior legs missing. Approximate115mm head width estimated from printed Fig1 magnification is not a published direct measurement. Restored300mm total length, body depth and limb completion are illustrative estimates. Tail supplemented by same-species NMS G1992.14.6; appendageIV terminal morphology by GLAHM A23078. Whyte2005 Fig1c supplies only general hibbertopteroid posture, not species identity or its giant trackmaker scale. No dense filtering hairs are claimed.
scientific_limits.zh: 主锚BMNH In.62181受压变形，后体卷于头下且后足远端缺失。头宽约115毫米来自图1印刷倍率估计，并非论文直接实测。补全体长300毫米、体厚及缺失足节为解释性估值；尾部借同种NMS G1992.14.6，第四附肢末端参考GLAHM A23078。Whyte2005图1c仅辅助该类群整体姿态，不借其巨型足迹尺寸或确定种身份。不宣称保存了密集滤食毛。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete conservative living reconstruction of broad domed headshield, short anterior sweep-feeding limbs, stout unequal walking limbs and heavy tapering segmented trunk with keeled telson; same-species composite, not a single complete fossil replica.
